content.title: Plan work that people can follow
content.lead: Teams use one shared workspace so plans, checks and reviews stay in step.

items.name: Alpine
items.title: Clear steps from first idea to finished page
items.body: Every change is reviewed by a person before it reaches the people who depend on it. Clear ownership keeps handoffs short and questions easy to route.

items.name: Pebblebrook Energy
items.title: One place for every plan and every review
items.body: Plain defaults get a new project running in an afternoon instead of a quarter. Reviewers see the same preview that readers will see, so surprises stay rare.

items.name: Maren Okonkwo
items.title: A calmer way to run a busy project
items.body: Built-in checks run on every change and report problems in words people can act on. Move between drafts, previews and published pages without losing your place.

items.name: Tobias Abernathy
items.title: Everything your team needs in one workspace
items.body: Guides, templates and worked examples help new teammates become productive in their first week. Short feedback loops turn small improvements into steady progress over a season.

items.name: Hollowell Transit
items.title: Ready for the way your team works
items.body: The editor suggests the next step while you type and never changes anything on its own. Practical advice from people who run these projects every day, written without jargon.

items.name: Sandpiper Health
items.title: Start small and grow at your pace
items.body: A single sign-in covers the whole workspace, including guests who only need to read. Comments stay attached to the line they discuss, even after the page is edited.

items.name: Ines Moreau
items.title: Tools that stay out of your way
items.body: Schedules, owners and dependencies sit side by side so conflicts are caught early. Teams tell us the biggest change is how little time goes into status updates now.

items.name: Callum Delacroix
items.title: See the whole picture at a glance
items.body: Review the facts, share the plan and ship with confidence that nothing was missed. We keep the interface small on purpose so the important things are easy to find.

items.title: From draft to published in an afternoon
items.body: Notes written once are reused everywhere they are relevant, which saves rewriting. Everyone gets the same fast experience on a laptop, a tablet or a phone.
